# Historical SQLite compatibility fixture

`storage-be94f75.db` is a real database generated by the public SQLite driver
at TSD commit `be94f75` (the pre-removal implementation). Its SHA-256 is
`0284f50ab0191ff3139cf758df94aefb010dbdc7184e27ed6544f03df91a3801`.

The fixture contains a `local`-scope document (`fixture/document`), one stream
record (`fixture.events`), and a blob (`fixture/blob`). It also has a legacy
scope admission row and purge receipt at generation 7. Those policy tables and
rows are intentionally retained as inert historical data when opened by newer
TSD code; the compatibility test confirms no payload or metadata is dropped.

To regenerate from the source commit, run from the TSD repository root:

```sh
mkdir -p target/be94-fixture-generator

git archive be94f75 | tar -x -C target/be94-fixture-generator
mkdir -p target/be94-fixture-generator/crates/tinystoragedrivers-sqlite/tests
cp crates/tinystoragedrivers-sqlite/tests/fixtures/generate-be94-fixture.rs.txt \
  target/be94-fixture-generator/crates/tinystoragedrivers-sqlite/tests/generate_legacy_fixture.rs
mkdir -p target/compiler-scratch crates/tinystoragedrivers-sqlite/tests/fixtures
TSD_BE94_FIXTURE_OUT="$PWD/crates/tinystoragedrivers-sqlite/tests/fixtures/storage-be94f75.db" \
TMPDIR="$PWD/target/compiler-scratch" CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 \
  cargo test --manifest-path target/be94-fixture-generator/Cargo.toml \
  -p tinystoragedrivers-sqlite --test generate_legacy_fixture
```

The generator uses only the historical `SqliteStorage`, `StorageBackend`,
`DocumentStore`, `StreamStore`, `BlobStore`, and `SqliteNative` public APIs.
